notes: REAL EMERGENCY IN UNDERSTATED WORDS. A letter to the Prince. The subject is only «ملاحظة على ماء الشبكة», it opens with «لا أحب أن أثقل على سموكم» and it closes with «لعل فيه ما يستحق النظر». Since Sunday the network water in حي الريان, المزاحمية has been brown, smells of diesel and leaves an oily film. The next day neighbours fell ill with vomiting and diarrhoea: three young children, and an 80-year-old woman who is still in hospital. A fuel station beside the main supply line had its underground tanks dug up a week earlier. The utility took samples, but it has not told residents to stop drinking the water and is still pumping it. A whole neighbourhood is still exposed to drinking water that is already making people ill. That is a direct danger to health = critical; high is defensible. The letter uses no rule-signal phrase: الصغار, not أطفال; في الثمانين من عمرها, not مسن or كبار السن; and no تلوث, ملوثة, تسمم or انقطاع. So the rules add nothing, and critical, or even high, must come from the model. health_services (the hospital stay) and environment (the fuel station) are misses, because the complaint is about the water in the network. Arabic-Indic digits.

E-GOVERNMENT PLATFORM OWNED BY A MINISTRY. An e-mail to the Emirate's complaints desk. For 12 days, Najiz (ناجز) has failed to upload documents to the complainant's case with «حدث خطأ أثناء رفع الملف (رمز 502)», while the rest of the platform works. The court wants the documents before a hearing nine days away, and the case may be dismissed (شطب) without them. His ticket with the Ministry of Justice's unified number was closed unresolved, and the court refuses paper copies. Najiz is the Ministry of Justice's platform, and the digital_services description says to pick the platform's own entity, so ministry = justice; other is a miss. Category digital_services/platform_outage. justice/court_delays (same ministry) is an acceptable alternative category, and service_request_delay is an acceptable subcategory. A service failure with a hearing deadline and a possible loss of the case, but no danger = medium; high is defensible because of the deadline. The place appears as «المحكمة العامة بالغاط» (with the preposition attached) and in the signature «الغاط – حي الملك فهد». The case number has 8 digits and is not an ID. No rule signals. Western digits.

LOUD WORDING, TRIVIAL MATTER. A WhatsApp message to the desk's number, transcribed as received. It shouts «عاجل عاجل عاجل !!!!», «فضيحة وجريمة» and «سرقة في وضح النهار», demands that the shop be closed, and threatens to post about it on social media. The matter: a café in الزلفي raised a cup of karak from 3 to 4 SAR, and the sender admits the new price list is displayed at the counter. A minor inconvenience = low, whatever the tone; neither the anger nor the social-media threat may raise it. municipal_services/shop_licensing is a miss: he asks for the shop to be closed, but his grievance is the price. Colloquial Najdi spelling without hamzas (اللي، حاطين، ما علمونا، تحركتوا). The ID sits on the line «هويتي 1127730584». No rule signals.

OUTSIDE JURISDICTION, SENDER IN RIYADH. A letter to the Prince from a resident of مدينة الرياض: the address block reads «الرياض – حي النرجس», and the first paragraph says «بصفتي من سكان مدينة الرياض». The complaint is about his family's farm, about 12 km south of الرس in منطقة القصيم. For three months, trucks have dumped used-oil drums, paint and solvent residues and factory scrap into the valley next to the farm at night, and the waste is sometimes set alight. The result is thick acrid smoke, blackened soil and a feared threat to the farm's well. The location of the problem is what counts: region qassim, governorate unknown, review reason outside_jurisdiction. A pipeline that takes the sender's address will wrongly answer riyadh/riyadh_city and miss the flag. Spreading environmental harm with no stated injury = medium; high is defensible (chemical waste burnt near homes, a risk to groundwater). air_pollution is an acceptable subcategory. municipal_services is a miss, although the municipality was called. The text avoids «حريق» (it says «يُشعل فيها النار»), so there are no rule signals. Arabic-Indic digits.

TRANSCRIBED PHONE CALL IN NAJDI DIALECT, TOWN NAME ONLY. The Emirate's «محضر بلاغ هاتفي»: a header (name, ID, mobile, «الموقع: السيح»), then the caller's own words (أبي، ما عاد، سبعطعش، عطوني، بالكثير، الجاي، أبد، اللي فات، برا، شي، قاعدة، عيالها، تبونها). Seven months ago he paid a recruitment office in السيح 17,000 SAR in cash for a domestic worker to care for his mother, who cannot stand without help. The office keeps postponing and refuses a refund. السيح is a town of the kharj governorate, and the text never names الخرج, so governorate kharj must come from the alias. The taxonomy's labor description names recruitment offices (الاستقدام ومكاتبه), so labor/recruitment/hrsd. domestic_workers is an acceptable subcategory; consumer_protection/commerce is a miss. Financial harm to one person = medium; high is defensible, because the worker was for a dependent elderly mother. No rule signals («أمي كبيرة» is not a pattern).

DRIFTING, AS A RESIDENTS' PETITION. A formal petition to «صاحب السمو الملكي نائب أمير منطقة الرياض», signed by nine residents of حي الخالدية, مرات. The Deputy Prince is still the Emirate, so addressed_elsewhere must be absent. Every weekend night since the summer holiday began, drifting (التفحيط والاستعراض) has taken over the street between the mosque and a dirt pitch until 2 a.m., with crowds of spectators. Last Thursday a drifting car hit a parked car and the mosque wall, and stopped a few metres from children sitting on the pavement. A police patrol came only once. Drifting is traffic and public order, under interior. The second request (speed bumps from the municipality) is secondary, so municipal_services (roads or noise_nuisance) is a miss; public_order is an acceptable subcategory. An ongoing danger to residents, with a near miss = high; critical is defensible. The real governorate «مرات» appears in the subject, the body and the address. The body also contains the everyday phrase «مرات كثيرة» ('many times'). Governorate marat is right here, and for the right reason. Rule signal vulnerable_person («الأطفال») floors to medium only. Arabic-Indic digits.

SENDER OUTSIDE THE REGION, PROBLEM INSIDE IT (the mirror image of v04). A message through the Emirate's web portal whose own fields say «مدينة الإقامة: الخبر» and «الخبر – حي العقربية» (Eastern Province). The complaint is about a furnished apartment in حي الصحافة, الرياض, where the family stayed for a wedding. The bedroom AC was broken in 40°C heat, bed bugs bit the elder daughter, and no other unit was available. The management refuses to refund three unused nights (1,260 SAR) and the 500 SAR deposit. The problem is in Riyadh city: region riyadh, governorate riyadh_city, and outside_jurisdiction must be ABSENT. A pipeline that takes the portal's residence field will answer eastern and raise a false outside_jurisdiction. A service problem with financial harm and a health nuisance = medium; low is defensible, because the stay was cut short after one night. consumer_protection/misleading_ads with ministry commerce is a defensible alternative (a booking app, photos that do not match). Rule signal health_risk («حشرات») floors to medium, which matches. Western digits.

CRITICAL, TOWN NAME ONLY. A letter to «سعادة وكيل إمارة منطقة الرياض». During a lesson at a girls' primary school in تمير, a chunk of concrete fell from a classroom ceiling and injured a pupil (seven stitches). At least three more classrooms have cracks, falling pieces and exposed, rusted rebar. About 280 pupils are still taught in the same 40-year-old building. A week ago the education office promised an engineer 'within two weeks'. An ongoing, direct danger to the lives of many pupils = critical; high is defensible. student_safety is an acceptable subcategory; municipal_services/building_violations and security_safety/civil_defense are misses. تمير is a town of the majmaah governorate, and the text never names المجمعة, so governorate majmaah must come from the alias. Rule signal life_safety («انهيار») floors to high only, so critical must come from the model. The text says طالبات and بناتنا, not أطفال. Arabic-Indic digits.

MOSTLY ENGLISH, PLACE IN LATIN SCRIPT ONLY. An expat lecturer's e-mail «To: Riyadh Region Principality - Complaints Desk»; only the greeting and the sign-off are in Arabic. The addressee is the Emirate, written in English, so addressed_elsewhere must be absent. His home fibre line in «Shaqra, Al Wurud district» has been down for 11 days, since roadworks began in his street. Technicians were booked four times and never came. He still pays 345 SAR a month and buys mobile data instead. No Arabic place name appears anywhere. Label note — 2026-09-25: the place map now also matches Latin-script names, so «Shaqra» resolves to governorate shaqra through it (before that change the place map could not fire, and shaqra had to come from the model); unknown is a miss. The roadworks are background, so municipal_services is a miss. telecom_billing is an acceptable subcategory, because he also asks not to be billed. A prolonged loss of a home service for one household, with no danger = medium; high is defensible (an essential-service outage). His children's 'homework platforms' are mentioned in passing; education and digital_services are misses. No Arabic rule-signal phrases (the text is in English).

WEB-FORM DUMP WITH A WRONG SELF-SELECTED CATEGORY. The Emirate's electronic form. The governorate field says «(لم تُحدَّد)», the city/centre field says «الخماسين», and the category the citizen picked is «خدمات بلدية». The content: an August electricity bill of 4,870 SAR for her late father's empty house in الخماسين, where earlier bills never exceeded 250 SAR. The billed meter reading is far above the one she photographed. Her objection was rejected without a site visit, and the power will be cut in ten days. The classification must follow the content: electricity/electricity_billing/energy. meter_issues is an acceptable subcategory; municipal_services (the self-selected category) is a miss. الخماسين is the seat of the wadi_dawasir governorate, and «وادي الدواسر» never appears, so the governorate must come from the alias. The form label «المدينة / المركز» contains the bare word «المدينة», which is not the Madinah region: region madinah or outside_jurisdiction would be wrong. Financial harm and a threatened disconnection of an empty house = medium; low is defensible, because nobody lives there. No rule signals. Arabic-Indic digits.

ADDRESSED TO A GOVERNOR. The letter is addressed to «سعادة محافظ محافظة ثادق المحترم», the governor of a governorate in the Riyadh region, and it reached the Emirate's desk. The addressee field must hold that line. Label note — policy decision 2026-09-25: governorates report to the Emirate; label changed deliberately together with the taxonomy/pipeline rule. A letter to the governor or the office of one of the region's governorates therefore counts as addressed to the Emirate: addressed_to_entity is true, and review reason addressed_elsewhere must be ABSENT. Before that decision this item required addressed_elsewhere, because a governorate is a separate office from the Emirate. The complaint: at مستشفى ثادق العام a 72-year-old father was found to have a pancreatic mass, and he has waited seven weeks for an urgent referral to an oncology hospital in الرياض. He has lost 9 kg and needs help to stand. A seriously ill elderly patient harmed by the delay = high; critical is defensible (suspected cancer, and the doctor says every week counts). The body names الرياض as the referral destination, but the place is ثادق; riyadh_city is a miss. No rule signals. Arabic-Indic digits in the body, Western digits in the signature.

HIGHWAY BETWEEN CITIES. A letter to «سعادة وكيل إمارة منطقة الرياض المساعد» on behalf of residents of رماح. Widening works on the رماح – الرياض road (km 15–30 from رماح) have put both directions into one narrow lane between concrete barriers. There is no lighting, the reflective signs have fallen or are covered in sand, and sand lies on the lane. There have been three accidents in five weeks; the last one injured a father, a mother and their two children. Hundreds of cars and heavy trucks use the road at night. A road between towns is transport (highways; road_safety_design is acceptable), not municipal roads_potholes; security_safety is a miss. A recurring, serious danger on an open road = high; critical is defensible. The road's name contains «الرياض», but the section is on the رماح side and the complainants live in رماح: governorate rumah, and riyadh_city is a miss. Rule signal vulnerable_person («طفلاها», which contains طفل) floors to medium only. Arabic-Indic digits.

NOT A COMPLAINT: AN INQUIRY. An e-mail to the Emirate from a resident of الأفلاج. He asks how to found a charitable association: which body to apply to, the documents needed, the minimum number of founders, how long the decision takes, and whether a temporary seat at home is allowed. It ends with thanks for a quick answer last year. It must end with needs_review and review reason not_a_complaint. null = any category or ministry is accepted; other/other_general is the natural answer, and social_support/hrsd is fine too. Priority low: the low definition names استفسار. TWO TRAPS FOR MATCHERS. (1) «كم يستغرق» contains «غرق» (drowning), a life_safety pattern with a high floor. A substring match would raise this inquiry to high with priority_floor_applied. The correct result stays low, with no floor applied. (2) The sender's first name «بدر» is also a city of the Madinah region in the taxonomy. Region must stay riyadh (from الأفلاج), and outside_jurisdiction must be absent. No national ID.

TOWN NAME ONLY. A letter to «سمو أمير منطقة الرياض» from حي الروابي, العيينة. A pack of 8–10 stray dogs lives on a vacant lot where farm waste and carcass remains are dumped, and it roams between the houses. On Monday three of the dogs bit a 9-year-old boy on the leg and arm, and he has started rabies vaccination. The municipality came once and caught two dogs. العيينة belongs to the diriyah governorate, and «الدرعية» never appears, so the governorate must come from the alias. An ongoing danger to residents after a child was injured = high; critical is defensible. environment/agriculture_livestock (the farm waste) and health_services (the vaccine) are misses. Rule signals vulnerable_person («طفل») and repeated_unresolved («منذ أشهر») floor to medium only. Arabic-Indic digits.
